findings.description: The proposed tests contain a streak-counting ambiguity: F001 says clearance_streak counts consecutive full-clearance rounds ending at the latest round, but F003 expects C0 round 3 to have streak=2 while rounds 1-2 are not eligible despite the stated 100% clearance across rounds 1-3.

The plan does not explicitly require the full completion-path test where an eligible high matrix_pin refusal is followed by recording waived_matrix_pin_high and then the same lock succeeds without any paid auditor invocation.

The fallback_blocked journey state is named in the objective, and F001 mentions conservative-fallback findings, but F003 only calls out plan_contract discrimination fixtures and does not require a concrete fallback-classed or unclassified high blocker case.

F002 asks the refusal output to name the exact disposition command, but also forbids default confirmation text anywhere in the path. That leaves the CLI contract under-specified and risks either a non-runnable command or an accidental canned confirmation.
